verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of GitLab supporting external CI/CD tools in place of its native pipelines; all CI/CD-related docs (e.g., gitlab-docs-8) describe GitLab's own build/test pipeline. One community comment even states the opposite experience — that services like TravisCI 'generally don't integrate with GitLab' (gitlab-comm-10) — reinforcing the lack of evidence for this capability.
